plan.title: Module 7: Scope Lifecycle and Implementation Authorization

narratives.Description: Deliver Module 7 and a guarded disposable lab that makes lifecycle state and implementation authorization observable without touching this training repository or any remote. This story is independently reviewable because it owns the only executable lab in the cohort, including its fictional fixture, safety helper, reset and recoverable cleanup, explained solution, platform evidence, and focused tests.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Probe the pinned Directive 0.112.0 lifecycle, session, and xBRIEF preflight command surfaces, then record exact behavior and any documentation drift in references/SOURCE-BASELINE.md and references/SOURCE-NOTES.md.
2. Author curriculum/modules/07-scope-lifecycle.md, labs/07-scope-lifecycle.md, the exact labs/fixtures/07-scope-lifecycle files, and solutions/lab-07-scope-lifecycle.md so proposed failure, task-driven promotion and activation, active success, completion, cancellation, reset, and cleanup are reproducible.
3. Add scripts/verify-module-7.mjs, its negative tests, and lifecycle fixture tests; update the exact indexes and run focused, portability, conformance, and aggregate evidence gates without claiming an unexecuted platform.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer learning Directive, I want to observe lifecycle transitions and preflight authorization in a disposable repository, so that I can distinguish approved scope from mutation-ready implementation authority.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the supplied fixture, the starting guard fails before mutation unless the canonical root is a unique temporary no-remote repository with the exact Directive 0.112.0 pin.

The lab records proposed-scope preflight failure; task-driven proposed-to-pending, active/running, completed, and cancelled transitions with folder/status agreement; and active-scope preflight success only after the required live implementation intent and session gates.
